recommendation: **Which scheme should you apply for?** You may be eligible for **BOTH** if you are: (1) a farmer with land in your own name, (2) NOT an income-tax payer, and (3) NOT a government employee/professional. PM-KISAN gives you guaranteed Rs. 6,000/year for any crop on your land. PMFBY adds insurance protection—it pays claims ONLY when your crops fail from natural disasters or pests. **Strategy:** Use PM-KISAN as regular income support, and PMFBY as insurance for crop failures. If you're a tenant/sharecropper, **only PMFBY will accept you** (with a valid tenure agreement). **Critical:** Check if your crops and district are 'notified' under PMFBY before applying. Visit official portals to verify your eligibility before applying.
